# Manuja Medhankara

> Cybersecurity Specialist & Systems Engineer based in Colombo, Sri Lanka (UTC+05:30).

Manuja Medhankara engineers resilient defensive architectures, conducts offensive web application penetration testing, and builds high-performance open-source security utilities in Rust, Tauri, Python, and Bash.

## Core Specializations

- **Penetration Testing**: Offensive web application security auditing, vulnerability chaining, blackbox & whitebox testing, OWASP Top 10 mitigation, REST/GraphQL API security analysis.
- **Linux Infrastructure Hardening**: Kernel sysctl tuning, AppArmor/SELinux profiles, strict user privilege models, firewall policies (nftables/iptables), and automated compliance auditing aligned with CIS Benchmarks and NIST 800-53 baselines.
- **Security Tooling & Software Engineering**: Engineering high-speed custom vulnerability scanners, automation daemons, and desktop defensive tooling using Rust, Tauri v2, SQLite WAL, Python, and Bash.
- **Network Reconnaissance & Forensics**: Protocol analysis, service fingerprinting, attack surface mapping, packet capture inspection (Wireshark, Scapy), and digital forensics.

## Selected Open Source Projects

- **[VulnRadar](https://github.com/manuja-me/vuln-radar)**: Desktop security workstation and non-intrusive vulnerability auditor built with Rust, Tauri v2, and Svelte 5. Features passive audits for SSL/TLS, DMARC/SPF, HTTP headers, RCE parameter heuristics, AI-assisted remediation prompts, and async TCP port discovery.
- **[Linux Hardening Suite](https://github.com/manuja-me)**: Automated compliance evaluation and system hardening framework for Linux systems (Arch, Debian, Ubuntu) adhering to CIS Benchmarks and NIST 800-53.
- **[Network Recon Pro](https://github.com/manuja-me)**: Asset discovery and protocol analysis framework featuring service fingerprinting and CVE catalog correlation.

## Key Technical Specifications

- **Primary Environments**: Arch Linux (custom hardened kernel), Kali Linux, Qubes OS
- **Toolchain**: Burp Suite, Metasploit, Wireshark, Nmap, Ghidra, GDB, Docker, Trivy
- **Languages**: Rust, Python, Bash, TypeScript, SQL
- **Standards & Baselines**: CIS Benchmarks, NIST SP 800-53, OWASP ASVS
